environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB forwards requests directly to the application on port 8080. No WAF rules are attached. The application is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name. Go version 1.19 is used (net/http does not strip CRLF from header values in this version).

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
